//: The contacts, numbers and groups you want to be alerted about.
//numbers: Phone numbers in full international format. + / spaces / dashes are ignored, so '+1 555-123 4567' == '15551234567'.
//groups: Match groups either by their exact WhatsApp name (subject) or by their JID (e.g. '1203...@g.us'). Names are matched case-insensitively.
//labels: Optional friendly names so alerts read nicely. Key = normalized number, value = label.
